$description: Typography. Each value becomes --uw-<group>-<name>. A [min, max] pair is a fluid size in rem: min on a 360 px wide screen, max from 1280 px, linear in between (clamp()). Font families are system stacks until the fonts are chosen and self-hosted with next/font (Task 2.4, PO to confirm).

font-family.display: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
font-family.body: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
font-family.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
